answer: Bind each agent key to an aged domain: the key must sit in a DNS TXT record on a domain registered over a year ago, and payouts ramp with registration age. Domains sharing a registrant, nameserver or hosting IP merge into one share, so sable.example and marble.example on one cheap host earn as one agent. A farm must pre-age N domains across independent registrars and hosts, paying N renewals every year; no bridge lets a fresh batch skip the wait.
